bottleneck: The /ready handler probes every dependency synchronously on each call. The vLLM probe has no GPU endpoint in the local profile and only returns on its ~5s ReadTimeout, so that timeout is the P50 floor. All 200 responses are HTTP 200 because vLLM is a non-mandatory probe in the container profile (LAB28_VLLM_REQUIRE_REAL=false) -> status "degraded", pod stays in rotation.
fix: Cache probe results with a short TTL (e.g. 2-5s) or run the probes concurrently with a per-probe deadline; drop the vLLM probe timeout to ~1s in the local profile.
